author.name: Reliability Ruth
author.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

challenge.name: The Committed Pallets
challenge.description: A supplier has confirmed a bulk order for a middle aisle promotion that ships next week, leaving no room for model error. #requirements_reuben# insists the acceptance criteria must be fully governed to guarantee the allocation logic is auditable before the trucks leave. #reliability_ruth# argues the criteria are sufficient as manual checks because the physical stock is already committed and the team needs to ship the feature immediately to handle the live orders.

output.content: We need to automate the acceptance criteria for the allocation logic. Manual checks are too slow for the live order window. If we automate them, the system can verify the logic instantly before the trucks leave. This lets us ship the feature immediately without waiting for a human review queue. More automation means faster feedback and fewer delays. I want the checks to run automatically every time a new configuration is deployed. This will ensure we can handle the committed pallets right now. The goal is to have zero manual steps in the validation loop so we can react to changes in real time. Please prioritize this automation work so we can get the feature live before the next promotion week starts.
output.reclassify_reason: The text expresses a strong desire for full automation to achieve real-time reaction and immediate feature release, indicating that exceeding the basic request for automation would further satisfy the author's goal of eliminating all manual delays.
